name: 表示名・説明・保存先・対象と確定をまとめる編集見出し
prompt:
Recreate the standalone Linear saved-view editor header shown in the primary screenshot crop. Match its wide 1579:173 aspect ratio (about 9.13:1), full rounded white container, thin neutral border, top information/action row, horizontal divider and bottom target/filter row. Keep the original screenshot crop authoritative for geometry, icon silhouettes, control order, selected state, border, spacing and colors; use the Japanese mock only for translated copy and text sizing.

In the upper row, preserve the small pale square with the original outlined thumbs-up icon at far left, then the view name 「優先度の高い作業」 in dark medium-weight type. Directly below, show the muted description 「優先度を「高」にした課題」. On the right, show the compact save destination group 「保存先」 followed by a small lock icon and 「個人」 inside the same rounded pill, then the plain text action 「キャンセル」, then the outlined rounded 「保存」 button. The original says Personal with a lock, meaning private/personal; do not turn it into a shared destination and do not use the mock's contradictory 「共有領域」 text.

Below the fine horizontal divider, place two compact rounded target tabs at left: 「課題」 selected with the source's subtle gray fill, and 「案件」 unselected with a light outline. At the far right, preserve the two separate small circular outline controls from the source: first a filter/funnel icon, then a sliders/settings icon. Keep the source's generous empty horizontal span between tabs and controls.

Use a clean white background, very light gray border/divider, dark title, muted gray description, and restrained neutral control labels. Preserve the original Linear-like spacing and visual weight. Do not add fields, extra controls, icons, account names, data or page background; keep this single header component edge-to-edge.
reviewNotes: v001 preserves the title, description, locked Personal destination translated as 個人, save/cancel actions and target/filter controls. Needs-correction because the 2164x726 canvas is 2.981:1 against the 1579x173 source crop at 9.127:1, leaving large blank margins around the panel.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
